\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Mean value inequality when $\Ric \ge 0$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0386 1. ch26:26.36\group Mean Value Properties

If $\Ric \ge 0$, $f\le 0$, and $\Delta f\ge 0$, prove that \[ f(O)\le \frac1{\omega _nr^n}\int _{B(O,r)}f\, d\mu \] for $0<r<\operatorname {inj}(O)$. \end{claim}
